create_language_pair_dataset: create a LanguagePairDataset instance wrapping source and target datasets with padding and alignment options
collate_samples_into_batch: collate a list of source-target sample dicts into a padded mini-batch tensor dictionary for model input
filter_indices_by_size: filter dataset sample indices by maximum source and target sequence length thresholds
compute_alignment_weights: compute inverse frequency weights for source-target alignment indices to balance alignment training
get_ordered_indices: get an ordered list of dataset indices sorted by target then source length for efficient batching
